rationale: Identity was properly verified via name + zip, and the agent acted on the correct account and items. However, the agent performed order-changing actions (initiated returns and a cancellation) without explicitly confirming the exact changes with the user, which violates policy. More critically, the user requested to cancel only the hose from the pending order and said not to cancel anything else if item-level cancellation wasn’t possible. The agent canceled the entire pending order, contrary to the user’s instruction. While the refund totals match the actions taken, the actions themselves were improper under the policy, so the interaction fails.
